en.text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心默默无声，专等候 神； 。

zhTraditional.text: 我的心默默無聲，專等候上帝； 。

en.text: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救；

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；

en.text: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

zhSimplified.text: 你们大家攻击一人，把他毁坏，

zhTraditional.text: 你們大家攻擊一人，把他毀壞，

en.text: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly.

zhSimplified.text: 他们彼此商议，专要从他的尊位上把他推下；

zhTraditional.text: 他們彼此商議，專要從他的尊位上把他推下；

en.text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心哪，你当默默无声，专等候 神， 。

zhTraditional.text: 我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候上帝， 。

en.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

zhSimplified.text: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救；

zhTraditional.text: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；

en.text: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

zhSimplified.text: 我的拯救、我的荣耀都在乎 神；

zhTraditional.text: 我的拯救、我的榮耀都在乎上帝；

en.text: Trust in him at all times, you people. out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.

zhSimplified.text: 你们众民当时时倚靠他，

zhTraditional.text: 你們眾民當時時倚靠他，

en.text: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
Don’t trust in oppression. become vain in robbery. If riches increase, set your heart on them.
God has spoken once; I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

zhSimplified.text: 神说了一次、两次，我都听见：

zhTraditional.text: 上帝說了一次、兩次，我都聽見：

en.text: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
